s0401.literal: Financial and grain affairs are numerous; verification and audit cannot cover everything, and fraud cannot be detected.
s0401.idiomatic: Financial and grain affairs are numerous; verification and audit cannot cover everything, and fraud cannot be detected.

s0402.literal: Those not yet completed should be allowed to be reviewed by the surveillance commission in the following year.
s0402.idiomatic: Those not yet completed should be allowed to be reviewed by the surveillance commission in the following year.

s0404.literal: On yisi day one hundred thousand shi of grain were granted to relieve impoverished commoners internally attached on the northern frontier.
s0404.idiomatic: On yisi day 100,000 shi of grain were granted to relieve impoverished commoners internally attached on the northern frontier.

s0405.literal: On jiyou day flooding afflicted Jiankang, Longxing, Linjiang, Ningguo, Taiping, Guangde, Raochi, and other places; thirty thousand shi of grain from Linjiang Route were issued for relief, and the prohibition on fishing at weirs and dams was lifted, allowing the people to fish and gather.
s0405.idiomatic: On jiyou day flooding afflicted Jiankang, Longxing, Linjiang, Ningguo, Taiping, Guangde, Raochi, and other places; 30,000 shi of grain from Linjiang Route were issued for relief, and the prohibition on fishing at weirs and dams was lifted, allowing the people to fish and gather.

s0406.literal: The captured Ryukyu persons were sent back to instruct their country, so that it would submit in allegiance.
s0406.idiomatic: The captured Ryukyu persons were sent back to instruct their country, so that it would submit in allegiance.

s0407.literal: Tubo, the Diaomen Pacification Commission, and the transport commission were merged and renamed the Diaomen Yutong Liya Changhe Xining Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.
s0407.idiomatic: Tubo, the Diaomen pacification commission, and the transport commission were merged and renamed the Diaomen Yutong Liya Changhe Xining military-civilian pacification commission.

s0408.literal: Hanlin academicians Wang Yun, Yan Fu, Wang Gou, Zhao Yupiao, Wang Zhigang, Yang Wenyu, and Wang Deyuan; and academicians of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies Wang Yong, Song Bo, Lu Zhi, Yelü Youshang, Li Tai, Hao Cai, and Yang Lin — all were aged and virtuous former ministers who maintained their posts in poverty — were specially granted more than two thousand one hundred ingots of notes.
s0408.idiomatic: Hanlin academicians Wang Yun, Yan Fu, Wang Gou, Zhao Yupiao, Wang Zhigang, Yang Wenyu, and Wang Deyuan; and academicians of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies Wang Yong, Song Bo, Lu Zhi, Yelü Youshang, Li Tai, Hao Cai, and Yang Lin — all were aged and virtuous former ministers who maintained their posts in poverty — were specially granted more than 2,100 ingots of notes.

s0409.literal: Three months' grain was granted to the people under Prince of Xiping Oljei; five hundred shi of millet to the Prince of Jin, one hundred twenty thousand ingots of notes to his subjects, and thirty thousand ingots to the Koryo, Jurchen, and Han armies garrisoned at Karakorum.
s0409.idiomatic: Three months' grain was granted to the people under Prince of Xiping Oljei; 500 shi of millet to the Prince of Jin, 120,000 ingots of notes to his subjects, and 30,000 ingots to the Koryo, Jurchen, and Han armies garrisoned at Karakorum.

s0410.literal: Second month, wuwu new moon: an edict ordered the Privy Council to merge impoverished military households.
s0410.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuwu new moon, an edict ordered the privy council to merge impoverished military households.

s0411.literal: On xinyou day Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Rooftop; Mars transgressed Jupiter.
s0411.idiomatic: On xinyou day Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at Rooftop; Mars transgressed Jupiter.

s0412.literal: On renxu day the Chongqing Pacification Commission's commander-in-chief headquarters was moved to Chengdu, and a military-civilian pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters was established in Fujian.
s0412.idiomatic: On renxu day the Chongqing pacification commission's commander-in-chief headquarters was moved to Chengdu, and a military-civilian pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters was established in Fujian.

s0413.literal: On yichou day the Zhexi Directorate for Waterworks and Corvée Fields was established, exclusively supervising water control.
s0413.idiomatic: On yichou day the Zhexi directorate for waterworks and corvée fields was established, exclusively supervising water control.

s0414.literal: Central Secretariat Right Vice Chancellor and Court of Imperial Esteem Vice Commissioner Zhang Jiusi was made grand councillor and deliberated central secretariat affairs.
s0414.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor and Court of Imperial Esteem vice commissioner Zhang Jiusi was made grand councillor and deliberated central secretariat affairs.

s0415.literal: On dingmao day Quanzhou was renamed Quanning Prefecture.
s0415.idiomatic: On dingmao day Quanzhou was renamed Quanning Prefecture.

s0416.literal: On jisi day the Emperor hunted at Huozhou.
s0416.idiomatic: On jisi day the Emperor hunted at Huozhou.

s0417.literal: On xinwei day the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.
s0417.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.

s0418.literal: The Jiangxi provincial detachments originally distributed as separate armies were merged into sixty-four posts.
s0418.idiomatic: The Jiangxi provincial detachments originally distributed as separate armies were merged into 64 posts.

s0419.literal: On bingzi day the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.
s0419.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.

s0420.literal: The Emperor instructed central secretariat officials, saying: "Each year the gold, silver, and paper currency received throughout the realm amounts to how much; grants to princes, imperial sons-in-law, and all construction expenditures amount to how much — compile the accounts and report.
s0420.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed central secretariat officials, saying, "Each year the gold, silver, and paper currency received throughout the realm amounts to how much; grants to princes, imperial sons-in-law, and all construction expenditures amount to how much — compile the accounts and report.

s0421.literal: " Right Chancellor Wanze said: "The annual revenue amounts to nineteen thousand taels of gold, sixty thousand taels of silver, and three million six hundred thousand ingots of notes, yet this still falls short; two hundred thousand ingots were also borrowed from the Zhiyuan note reserve. From now on I venture to request thrift.
s0421.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Wanze said, "The annual revenue amounts to 19,000 taels of gold, 60,000 taels of silver, and 3,600,000 ingots of notes, yet this still falls short; 200,000 ingots were also borrowed from the Zhiyuan note reserve. From now on I venture to request thrift.

s0422.literal: " The Emperor commended and accepted this.
s0422.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and accepted this.

s0423.literal: All construction projects within and without the court were halted.
s0423.idiomatic: All construction projects within and without the court were halted.

s0424.literal: On guimao day an edict forbade princes and imperial sons-in-law to sacrifice without authorization at the sacred mountains and seas;
s0424.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict forbade princes and imperial sons-in-law to sacrifice without authorization at the sacred mountains and seas;

s0425.literal: an order further forbade route armies and powerful households from allowing livestock to graze freely and damage agriculture.
s0425.idiomatic: an order further forbade route armies and powerful households from allowing livestock to graze freely and damage agriculture.

s0426.literal: On yiyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
s0426.idiomatic: On yiyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

s0427.literal: The Jiankang gold, silver, and copper smelting transport commission was abolished; gold-washing households were returned to their original registers, and annual gold quotas were assigned to the responsible offices.
s0427.idiomatic: The Jiankang gold, silver, and copper smelting transport commission was abolished; gold-washing households were returned to their original registers, and annual gold quotas were assigned to the responsible offices.

s0428.literal: An edict directed surveillance commissions to cultivate talent in preparation for selection and appointment.
s0428.idiomatic: An edict directed surveillance commissions to cultivate talent in preparation for selection and appointment.

s0429.literal: Princes' attendants were forbidden to borrow crane-control credentials and belts to harass the people.
s0429.idiomatic: Princes' attendants were forbidden to borrow crane-control credentials and belts to harass the people.

s0430.literal: An edict directed that in every commandery where commoners were lazy in sowing or local offices failed in exhortation and supervision, each route's surveillance commission should punish them.
s0430.idiomatic: An edict directed that in every commandery where commoners were lazy in sowing or local offices failed in exhortation and supervision, each route's surveillance commission should punish them.

s0431.literal: The number of branch secretariat grand councillors was reduced to two.
s0431.idiomatic: The number of branch secretariat grand councillors was reduced to two.

s0432.literal: On bingzi day Liang Degui was made central secretariat grand councillor, and Yang Yanlong central secretariat right vice chancellor.
s0432.idiomatic: On bingzi day Liang Degui was made central secretariat grand councillor, and Yang Yanlong central secretariat right vice chancellor.

s0433.literal: Three hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted to Zhahu'er's subjects; thirty thousand ingots to close attendants Bayan Temür and others; thirty-four thousand four hundred-odd ingots for Yexian Temür and others to purchase horses; and sixty thousand ingots to Prince of Zhennan Toghan.
s0433.idiomatic: 300,000 ingots of notes were granted to Zhahu'er's subjects; 30,000 ingots to close attendants Bayan Temür and others; 34,400-odd ingots for Yexian Temür and others to purchase horses; and 60,000 ingots to Prince of Zhennan Toghan.

s0434.literal: Flooding and drought afflicted Jiaxing and Jiangyin in Zhexi, Liyang in Jiankang in Jiangdong, and Chizhou; all were granted relief.
s0434.idiomatic: Flooding and drought afflicted Jiaxing and Jiangyin in Zhexi, Liyang in Jiankang in Jiangdong, and Chizhou; all were granted relief.

s0435.literal: Flooding afflicted Hanyang and Hanchuan in Huguang Province; their field rent was remitted.
s0435.idiomatic: Flooding afflicted Hanyang and Hanchuan in Huguang Province; their field rent was remitted.

s0436.literal: Rats damaged grain crops in Shazhou, Gansu Province; hail struck Tanzhou in Dadu; locusts afflicted Guide and other places.
s0436.idiomatic: Rats damaged grain crops in Shazhou, Gansu Province; hail struck Tanzhou in Dadu; locusts afflicted Guide and other places.

s0437.literal: Third month, dinghai new moon: the annual rental income of seven hundred fifty ingots of notes from the old Yellow River embankment at Daming Route for Longfu Palace was abolished.
s0437.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dinghai new moon, the annual rental income of 750 ingots of notes from the old Yellow River embankment at Daming Route for Longfu Palace was abolished.

s0438.literal: An order forbade officials from accepting bribes and then summoning the briber to report to various offices; such reports were not to be received at will.
s0438.idiomatic: An order forbade officials from accepting bribes and then summoning the briber to report to various offices; such reports were not to be received at will.

s0439.literal: On wuzi day an edict directed that Buddhist monks guilty of fornication, theft, and fraud should be judged exclusively by civil officials; lighter cases were to be settled in consultation with monastic officials, and those who failed to attend consultation were to be punished.
s0439.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict directed that Buddhist monks guilty of fornication, theft, and fraud should be judged exclusively by civil officials; lighter cases were to be settled in consultation with monastic officials, and those who failed to attend consultation were to be punished.

s0440.literal: On gengyin day it was ordered that when ten-thousand-household commanders went on campaign, their seals should be held by deputies and not entrusted to sons and younger relatives to conduct affairs in violation of law.
s0440.idiomatic: On gengyin day it was ordered that when ten-thousand-household commanders went on campaign, their seals should be held by deputies and not entrusted to sons and younger relatives to conduct affairs in violation of law.

s0441.literal: Idle farmland in the Two Huai was granted to Mongol troops.
s0441.idiomatic: Idle farmland in the Two Huai was granted to Mongol troops.

s0442.literal: On renzi day censorate officials said: "Daozhou Route darughachi Alin Buqa and prefect Zhou Kejing falsely reported wheat ripening and did not relieve famine victims; although amnesty covered them, their rank should be reduced by one grade.
s0442.idiomatic: On renzi day censorate officials said, "Daozhou Route darughachi Alin Buqa and prefect Zhou Kejing falsely reported wheat ripening and did not relieve famine victims; although amnesty covered them, their rank should be reduced by one grade.

s0444.literal: On renzi day an edict ennobled Eastern Mount Yishan as Prince Yuande Dong'an, Southern Mount Kuaiji as Prince Zhaode Shunying, Western Mount Wushan as Prince Chengde Yongjing, and Northern Mount Yiwulü as Prince Zhende Guangning; they were to be sacrificed to annually together with the sacred peaks and rivers, and this was established as regulation.
s0444.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ennobled Eastern Mount Yishan as Prince Yuande Dong'an, Southern Mount Kuaiji as Prince Zhaode Shunying, Western Mount Wushan as Prince Chengde Yongjing, and Northern Mount Yiwulü as Prince Zhende Guangning; they were to be sacrificed to annually together with the sacred peaks and rivers, and this was established as regulation.

s0445.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuwu day: the army campaigning against Burmakha was recalled to its home base.
s0445.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu day, the army campaigning against Burmakha was recalled to its home base.

s0446.literal: On gengshen day, because Yesudai'er had mobilized Gansu garrison troops without authorization, Bayan and others were dispatched to flog him.
s0446.idiomatic: On gengshen day, because Yesudai'er had mobilized Gansu garrison troops without authorization, Bayan and others were dispatched to flog him.

s0447.literal: Ninety thousand ingots of notes were granted to Dadu gate qariq guards and others, and forty-four thousand ingots to textile workers.
s0447.idiomatic: 90,000 ingots of notes were granted to Dadu gate qariq guards and others, and 44,000 ingots to textile workers.

s0448.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain from Qingyuan were issued, with the price reduced to relieve famine victims.
s0448.idiomatic: 50,000 shi of grain from Qingyuan were issued, with the price reduced to relieve famine victims.

s0449.literal: Locusts afflicted one hundred fifty subordinate counties in Jiangnan, Shandong, Jiang-Zhe, the Two Huai, and Yannan.
s0449.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted 150 subordinate counties in Jiangnan, Shandong, Jiang-Zhe, the Two Huai, and Yannan.

s0450.literal: Fifth month, xinmao day: the Hainan Li military ten-thousand-household office and the Li barbarian garrison-farming ten-thousand-household office were abolished, and their affairs were merged into the Qiongzhou Route Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.
s0450.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, the Hainan Li military ten-thousand-household office and the Li barbarian garrison-farming ten-thousand-household office were abolished, and their affairs were merged into the Qiongzhou Route military-civilian pacification commission.

s0451.literal: The surplus wine tax at Xiamalin was abolished.
s0451.idiomatic: The surplus wine tax at Xiamalin was abolished.

s0452.literal: On renchen day Central Secretariat Right Vice Chancellor He Rongzu was made grand councillor and deliberated central secretariat affairs; Huguang Left Vice Chancellor Badumasin was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.
s0452.idiomatic: On renchen day central secretariat right vice chancellor He Rongzu was made grand councillor and deliberated central secretariat affairs; Huguang left vice chancellor Badumasin was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.

s0453.literal: Famine afflicted the commanderies of Huai West; two hundred thousand shi of Jiangxi rice were transported by canal to supply relief loans.
s0453.idiomatic: Famine afflicted the commanderies of Huai West; 200,000 shi of Jiangxi rice were transported by canal to supply relief loans.

s0454.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to dispatch envoys to supervise selections for offices of rank six and below in Yunnan, Sichuan, Haibei, Hainan, Guangxi, the Two Jiang, Guangdong, and Fujian.
s0454.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to dispatch envoys to supervise selections for offices of rank six and below in Yunnan, Sichuan, Haibei, Hainan, Guangxi, the Two Jiang, Guangdong, and Fujian.

s0455.literal: On wuxu day the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.
s0455.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.

s0456.literal: On renyin day drought afflicted Pingluan Route; five hundred shi of rice were issued, with the price reduced for relief.
s0456.idiomatic: On renyin day drought afflicted Pingluan Route; 500 shi of rice were issued, with the price reduced for relief.

s0457.literal: On jiyou day Princess Nianbulie's consort Zhahuzhen fraudulently added impoverished households under her jurisdiction and drew more than ten thousand six hundred ingots of notes; a jarquchi was dispatched together with princely household officials to recover them.
s0457.idiomatic: On jiyou day Princess Nianbulie's consort Zhahuzhen fraudulently added impoverished households under her jurisdiction and drew more than 10,600 ingots of notes; a jarquchi was dispatched together with princely household officials to recover them.

s0458.literal: Drought afflicted Weihui and Shunde; strong winds damaged wheat; their field rent was remitted for one year.
s0458.idiomatic: Drought afflicted Weihui and Shunde; strong winds damaged wheat; their field rent was remitted for one year.

s0459.literal: An edict directed that in the twenty-four cities under Commander-in-Chief Wang Weizheng's jurisdiction, wherever the Prince of Anxi, other princes, and Duosima came to reside, they should share tax and corvée burdens equally with registered households.
s0459.idiomatic: An edict directed that in the 24 cities under Commander-in-Chief Wang Weizheng's jurisdiction, wherever the Prince of Anxi, other princes, and Duosima came to reside, they should share tax and corvée burdens equally with registered households.

s0460.literal: Tamna presented local products as tribute.
s0460.idiomatic: Tamna presented local products as tribute.

s0461.literal: A star fell as a meteorite at Chongren in Fuzhou.
s0461.idiomatic: A star fell as a meteorite at Chongren in Fuzhou.

s0462.literal: The School of Practical Application was restored.
s0462.idiomatic: The School of Practical Application was restored.

s0463.literal: The Karakorum Pacification Commission Commander-in-Chief Headquarters was established; Hulachu, Yelü Xizhou, and Nalin Hela were all made pacification commissioners and commanders-in-chief, bearing tiger tallies.
s0463.idiomatic: The Karakorum pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters was established; Hulachu, Yelü Xizhou, and Nalin Hela were all made pacification commissioners and commanders-in-chief, bearing tiger tallies.

s0464.literal: Thirty thousand ingots of notes each were granted to the qariq guards of both capitals.
s0464.idiomatic: 30,000 ingots of notes each were granted to the qariq guards of both capitals.

s0465.literal: Sixth month, gengshen day: censorate officials said: "Under the Song, Jiangnan practiced the dual-tax system; since Arigh Aqa changed it to a door-levy, tax revenues rose to fifty thousand ingots.
s0465.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen day, censorate officials said, "Under the Song, Jiangnan practiced the dual-tax system; since Arigh Aqa changed it to a door-levy, tax revenues rose to 50,000 ingots.

s0466.literal: Now Pacification Commissioner Zhang Guoji requests restoring the summer tax to levy it together with the door-levy to seek promotion; Hunan and Hubei suffer again.
s0466.idiomatic: Now pacification commissioner Zhang Guoji requests restoring the summer tax to levy it together with the door-levy to seek promotion; Hunan and Hubei suffer again.

s0467.literal: " The Emperor ordered the central secretariat to abolish it promptly.
s0467.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the central secretariat to abolish it promptly.

s0468.literal: Powerful families and ortoq were forbidden to seize grain-transport boats and vessels on the Dadu canal.
s0468.idiomatic: Powerful families and ortoq were forbidden to seize grain-transport boats and vessels on the Dadu canal.

s0469.literal: Surveillance Commissioner Tuohuan of the Western Censorate was dismissed for accepting bribes and acting unlawfully.
s0469.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioner Tuohuan of the western censorate was dismissed for accepting bribes and acting unlawfully.

s0470.literal: Princes were forbidden to issue orders without authorization; those who opened and read them in violation of precedent, together with the envoys they dispatched, were to be detained and reported.
s0470.idiomatic: Princes were forbidden to issue orders without authorization; those who opened and read them in violation of precedent, together with the envoys they dispatched, were to be detained and reported.

s0471.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed Horn.
s0471.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed Horn.

s0472.literal: An edict directed that miscellaneous-category households in Shaanxi share corvée burdens equally with commoners, and strictly forbade private salt under the Shaanxi transport commission.
s0472.idiomatic: An edict directed that miscellaneous-category households in Shaanxi share corvée burdens equally with commoners, and strictly forbade private salt under the Shaanxi transport commission.

s0473.literal: The Palace Inner Storehouse was established.
s0473.idiomatic: The Palace Inner Storehouse was established.

s0474.literal: Prince Yuemuhuer was granted one thousand two hundred fifty taels of gold; Ulus Buqa and his mother one thousand taels each; silver and notes were granted in varying amounts.
s0474.idiomatic: Prince Yuemuhuer was granted 1,250 taels of gold; Ulus Buqa and his mother 1,000 taels each; silver and notes were granted in varying amounts.

s0475.literal: Locusts afflicted fifty places in Shandong, Henan, Yannan, and Shanbei; locusts also afflicted Jinyuan County, Daning Route, Liaodong Circuit in Shanbei.
s0475.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted 50 places in Shandong, Henan, Yannan, and Shanbei; locusts also afflicted Jinyuan County, Daning Route, Liaodong Circuit in Shanbei.

s0476.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guisi day: the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.
s0476.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guisi day, the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.

s0477.literal: Heavy rain afflicted Bianliang and other places; the river burst and destroyed dikes, flooding grain crops and dwellings in several counties of Guide; their field rent was remitted for one year.
s0477.idiomatic: Heavy rain afflicted Bianliang and other places; the river burst and destroyed dikes, flooding grain crops and dwellings in several counties of Guide; their field rent was remitted for one year.

s0478.literal: Minister of Works Na Huai, Censor Liu Geng, and others were dispatched to block it; starting from Pukou, ninety-six embankments were built in all.
s0478.idiomatic: Minister of Works Na Huai, Censor Liu Geng, and others were dispatched to block it; starting from Pukou, 96 embankments were built in all.

s0479.literal: On renyin day an edict directed that from now on, if princes, imperial sons-in-law, and close attendants memorialized without going through the central secretariat and presumptuously transmitted orders to the outside, they were to be punished.
s0479.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict directed that from now on, if princes, imperial sons-in-law, and close attendants memorialized without going through the central secretariat and presumptuously transmitted orders to the outside, they were to be punished.

s0480.literal: King Wang Seon of Koryo killed persons on his own authority; an edict dispatched Central Secretariat Right Vice Chancellor Yang Yanlong and Privy Council Associate Administrator Hong Junxiang to summon him to attend court, while his father Ju continued to administer state affairs.
s0480.idiomatic: King Wang Seon of Koryo killed persons on his own authority; an edict dispatched central secretariat right vice chancellor Yang Yanlong and privy council associate administrator Hong Junxiang to summon him to attend court, while his father Ju continued to administer state affairs.

s0481.literal: Gold, silver, and notes were granted in varying amounts to princes Yilianzhen and others.
s0481.idiomatic: Gold, silver, and notes were granted in varying amounts to princes Yilianzhen and others.

s0482.literal: Flooding afflicted Jiangxi and Jiang-Zhe; twenty-four thousand nine hundred-odd famine victims were granted relief.
s0482.idiomatic: Flooding afflicted Jiangxi and Jiang-Zhe; 24,900-odd famine victims were granted relief.

s0483.literal: Eighth month, renxu day: the moon transgressed Winnowing Basket.
s0483.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renxu day, the moon transgressed Winnowing Basket.

s0484.literal: On guimao day ten thousand horses were granted to the Mongol expeditionary army in Sichuan.
s0484.idiomatic: On guimao day 10,000 horses were granted to the Mongol expeditionary army in Sichuan.

s0485.literal: Ninth month, jichou day, the Emperor's birthday: the court halted at Zugui and received congratulations from princes and officials of all ranks.
s0485.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jichou day, the Emperor's birthday: the court halted at Zugui and received congratulations from princes and officials of all ranks.

s0486.literal: Champa, Java, and Jinzhi each presented local products as tribute.
s0486.idiomatic: Champa, Java, and Jinzhi each presented local products as tribute.

s0487.literal: Cattle and carts were granted to the rotational garrison troops at Karakorum.
s0487.idiomatic: Cattle and carts were granted to the rotational garrison troops at Karakorum.

s0488.literal: On bingshen day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0488.idiomatic: On bingshen day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0489.literal: On xinchou day the moon transgressed the southern star of the Five Chariots.
s0489.idiomatic: On xinchou day the moon transgressed the southern star of the Five Chariots.

s0490.literal: Guanghai and the Left and Right Two Rivers garrison troops were ordered to rotate garrison duty every two or three years according to the former regulation.
s0490.idiomatic: Guanghai and the Left and Right Two Rivers garrison troops were ordered to rotate garrison duty every two or three years according to the former regulation.

s0491.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.
s0491.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.

s0492.literal: Privy Council Vice Commissioner Talaghudai was guilty of embezzlement; the censorate was ordered to try him.
s0492.idiomatic: Privy council vice commissioner Talaghudai was guilty of embezzlement; the censorate was ordered to try him.

s0493.literal: On jiyou day the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.
s0493.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.

s0494.literal: On gengxu day garrison farming was established at Ji and Gan;
s0494.idiomatic: On gengxu day garrison farming was established at Ji and Gan;

s0495.literal: redundant staff within and without the court was reduced.
s0495.idiomatic: redundant staff within and without the court was reduced.

s0496.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiayin new moon: sea-transport grain was increased to seven hundred thousand shi.
s0496.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiayin new moon, sea-transport grain was increased to 700,000 shi.

s0497.literal: On renxu day Venus transgressed Ox.
s0497.idiomatic: On renxu day Venus transgressed Ox.

s0498.literal: The Mongol Chief Ten-Thousand-Household Office was established at Fengxiang; two offices of native chiefs for the Pingzhu and Liudong Man barbarians were established, with forty-four local officials appointed.
s0498.idiomatic: The Mongol chief ten-thousand-household office was established at Fengxiang; two offices of native chiefs for the Pingzhu and Liudong Man barbarians were established, with 44 local officials appointed.

s0499.literal: On wuyin day the moon transgressed the distance star of Horn.
s0499.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon transgressed the distance star of Horn.

s0500.literal: The censorate was ordered to inspect and impeach Privy Council case records.
s0500.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered to inspect and impeach privy council case records.
